scenarios.prompt: here's my idea for an app: a habit tracker for climbers

expect.behavior: restates target users in terms of their jobs-to-be-done, not just who they are
web-searches the competitive landscape as of today and date-stamps the claims
makes sure the single question round covers every fit-map removal, not just the open-ended items

reject: proceeds to the brief without a question round
presents competitor claims with no date or source

scenarios.prompt: turn these plan documents into a build plan

expect.behavior: splits value-add candidates into what's already free in the foundation versus genuinely new build, not a single undifferentiated list
names the decisions the input never made instead of silently inventing them
opens B1 with the thinnest end-to-end slice of the core flow

reject: starts the backlog at a feature row rather than an end-to-end slice
fills the input's gaps with assumptions it never surfaces
pads the value-add list to look thorough

expect.behavior: treats an existing product brief as a resume/revision and confirms scope instead of starting over
routes foundation defects into an upstream-candidates section without blocking on them
treats a bare re-run with no new input as an automatic resume from the existing brief, distinct from a re-run carrying new input
expect.anchor: a bare re-run with no new input

reject: blocks the derived project on an upstream fix
commits the inception output before sign-off
